description: This file defines a PHP client class for interacting with the Amazon Lex Runtime Service, including method signatures for various operations and their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: LexRuntimeServiceClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Lex Runtime Service, extending the base AWS client.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a session with Amazon Lex.

methods.name: deleteSessionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a session with Amazon Lex.

methods.name: postContent
methods.description: Sends user input to Amazon Lex and receives the response.

methods.name: postContentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends user input to Amazon Lex.

methods.name: postText
methods.description: Sends text input to Amazon Lex for processing.

methods.name: postTextAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends text input to Amazon Lex.

methods.name: putSession
methods.description: Creates or updates a session with Amazon Lex.

methods.name: putSessionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a session.
